# spoke Provider

Experimental Spoke provider for the provisional `mock-v1` management API. No live platform service is qualified. Credentials come from `SPOKE_TOKEN` or `token_file`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Illustrative configuration for the provisional mock-v1 API.
# Run `just test-acc` for an automatically configured local fixture.
provider "spoke" {
  endpoint        = "https://management.example.invalid"
  organization_id = "org-example"
  project_id      = "project-example"
  environment_id  = "env-example"

  # Supply credentials through SPOKE_TOKEN or an external token_file.
  # Set ca_file when the endpoint uses a private CA; TLS stays verified.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Explicit HTTPS management origin. No default production target.
- `environment_id` (String) Expected environment ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Expected organization ID.
- `project_id` (String) Expected project ID.

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Path to additional PEM CA certificates. TLS verification remains enabled.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Total timeout per lifecycle operation, including polling; defaults to 60 seconds. Range: 1–3600.
- `token_file` (String) Path to an external machine credential. Takes precedence over `SPOKE_TOKEN`; credential bytes are not schema attributes.
